name: Veils of the Past
source:
How do you solve a mystery when every truth rewrites the world around you?

A young woman disappears in a remote coastal town, echoing the unsolved case of your own sister. As detective Alex Hart, you return home chasing answers… and running from memories you can’t trust.

What begins as straightforward missing-person case spirals into a psychological descent shaped entirely by the clues you uncover. Every small discovery can fracture relationships, shift the nature of reality, or pull you into one of four radically different storylines—each exposing a separate truth about what really happened.
Some are grounded in human cruelty.
Some reshape the rules of memory and identity.
And one may cost you everything.

This is not a story that branches at the end.
It is a story that metamorphoses based on the choices you make along the way.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3878630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当每一个真相都改写你周围的世界时，你如何解开谜团？

一名年轻女子在一个偏远的沿海小镇失踪，这与你姐姐悬而未决的案件相呼应。作为侦探亚历克斯·哈特，你回到家中寻找答案……并逃离你无法信任的记忆。

一开始是一个简单的失踪人口案件，后来逐渐演变成完全由你发现的线索塑造的心理下降。每一个小发现都可能破坏关系，改变现实的本质，或者将你带入四个截然不同的故事情节之一——每个故事情节都揭露了真正发生的事情的一个单独的真相。
有些是基于人类的残酷行为。
有些重塑了记忆和身份的规则。
而其中一个可能会让你付出一切。

这不是一个结局有分支的故事。
这是一个根据你一路上所做的选择而发生变化的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3878630/]Steam[/url]]
